worldcombat.skill.detect.summary: Read the next attack inside a very short window and fully evade it, earning a burst of opening (Speed by default, Attack if configured). Repeated use tends to fail.
worldcombat.skill.detect.description.0: Opens a %1$s reading window and blocks the next attack during it. Success grants an opening for %2$s, raising Speed or Attack by up to %3$s stages; expiry or removal ends only this boost.
worldcombat.skill.detect.description.2: Repeat-use failure rate %1$s: reading again within about 9 seconds adds about 25% each time (up to about 85%); a failed read simply does nothing, and the count resets after about 9 seconds without reading.
worldcombat.skill.detect.use.0: Tear apart the first blow the moment it starts
worldcombat.skill.detect.use.1: Read while closing, then strike back
worldcombat.skill.detect.preference.stri: Off (reposition): the read raises Speed with a wider window (x1.15), using the opening to create distance. On (counter): it raises Attack, but window x0.85, recover +2 ticks and cooldown +8 ticks.
worldcombat.skill.detect.preference.ai.r: Consider reading once a threat enters this range. Larger raises the curtain earlier but may read before the opponent acts.
worldcombat.skill.detect.description.win: The read window opens once focus ends; it only answers attacks from an enemy, self-inflicted or sourceless environmental damage does not spend it, and a window that ends unread simply misses. A successful read immediately raises one ability stage: Speed by default, Attack when Counter is on.
